tEn: ImageBind: One Embedding Space To Bind Them All
tZh: ImageBind：一个嵌入空间绑定所有
sEn: ImageBind learns a joint embedding across six modalities using only image-paired data, enabling zero-shot cross-modal transfer.
sZh: ImageBind仅使用图像配对数据学习六种模态的联合嵌入，实现了零样本跨模态迁移。
absEn: We present ImageBind, an approach to learn a joint embedding across six different modalities - images, text, audio, depth, thermal, and IMU data. We show that all combinations of paired data are not necessary to train such a joint embedding, and only image-paired data is sufficient to bind the modalities together. ImageBind can leverage recent large scale vision-language models, and extends their zero-shot capabilities to new modalities just by using their natural pairing with images. It enables novel emergent applications 'out-of-the-box' including cross-modal retrieval, composing modalities with arithmetic, cross-modal detection and generation. The emergent capabilities improve with the strength of the image encoder and we set a new state-of-the-art on emergent zero-shot recognition tasks across modalities, outperforming specialist supervised models. Finally, we show strong few-shot recognition results outperforming prior work, and that ImageBind serves as a new way to evaluate vision models for visual and non-visual tasks.
absZh: 我们提出ImageBind，一种学习跨六种不同模态（图像、文本、音频、深度、热成像和IMU数据）的联合嵌入的方法。我们表明，训练这样的联合嵌入并不需要所有配对数据的组合，仅图像配对数据就足以将模态绑定在一起。ImageBind可以利用最近的大规模视觉-语言模型，并通过与图像的自然配对将其零样本能力扩展到新模态。它实现了开箱即用的新涌现应用，包括跨模态检索、用算术组合模态、跨模态检测和生成。涌现能力随着图像编码器的强度而提高，我们在跨模态的涌现零样本识别任务上达到了新的最先进水平，优于专业监督模型。最后，我们展示了强大的少样本识别结果，优于先前的工作，并且ImageBind作为评估视觉模型在视觉和非视觉任务上的新方法。

paras.en: Abstract We present ImageBind, an approach to learn a joint embedding across six different modalities - images, text, audio, depth, thermal, and IMU data. We show that all combinations of paired data are not necessary to train such a joint embedding, and only image-paired data is sufficient to bind the modalities together. ImageBind can leverage recent large scale vision-language models, and extends their zero-shot capabilities to new modalities just by using their natural pairing with images. It enables novel emergent applications 'out-of-the-box' including cross-modal retrieval, composing modalities with arithmetic, cross-modal detection and generation. The emergent capabilities improve with the strength of the image encoder and we set a new state-of-the-art on emergent zero-shot recognition tasks across modalities, outperforming specialist supervised models. Finally, we show strong few-shot recognition results outperforming prior work, and that ImageBind serves as a new way to evaluate vision models for visual and non-visual tasks. * Equal technical contribution.
paras.zh: 摘要 我们提出ImageBind，一种学习跨六种不同模态（图像、文本、音频、深度、热成像和IMU数据）联合嵌入的方法。我们展示了训练这样的联合嵌入并不需要所有配对数据组合，仅图像配对数据就足以将各模态绑定在一起。ImageBind可以利用近期大规模视觉-语言模型，并通过它们与图像的自然配对，将其零样本能力扩展到新模态。它实现了新颖的即开即用涌现应用，包括跨模态检索、模态算术组合、跨模态检测和生成。涌现能力随图像编码器的强度提升而增强，我们在跨模态的涌现零样本识别任务上达到了新的最先进水平，超越了专门监督模型。最后，我们展示了强大的少样本识别结果，优于先前工作，并且ImageBind可作为评估视觉模型在视觉和非视觉任务上表现的新方法。* 同等技术贡献。

paras.en: A single image can bind together many experiences – an image of a beach can remind us of the sound of waves, the texture of the sand, a breeze, or even inspire a poem. This ‘binding’ property of images offers many sources of supervision to learn visual features, by aligning them with any of the sensory experiences associated with images. Ideally, for a single joint embedding space, visual features should be learned by aligning to all of these sensors. However, this requires acquiring all types and combinations of paired data with the same set of images, which is infeasible. Recently, many methods learn image features aligned with text [1, 31, 46, 60, 64, 65, 82, 83], audio [3, 4, 50, 55, 56, 70] etc. These methods use a single pair of modalities or, at best, a few visual modalities. However, the final embeddings are limited to the pairs of modalities used for training. Thus, video-audio embeddings cannot directly be used for image-text tasks and vice versa. A major obstacle in learning a true joint embedding is the absence of large quantities of multimodal data where all modalities are present together.
paras.zh: 一张图像可以将许多体验结合在一起——一张海滩的图像可以让我们想起海浪声、沙子的纹理、微风，甚至激发一首诗。这种图像的‘绑定’属性提供了许多监督来源，通过学习视觉特征，将其与图像相关的任何感官体验对齐。理想情况下，对于单个联合嵌入空间，视觉特征应该通过对齐所有这些传感器来学习。然而，这需要获取与同一组图像配对的所有类型和组合的数据，这是不可行的。最近，许多方法学习与文本[1,31,46,60,64,65,82,83]、音频[3,4,50,55,56,70]等对齐的图像特征。这些方法使用单一模态对，或者最多使用几种视觉模态。然而，最终的嵌入仅限于用于训练的模态对。因此，视频-音频嵌入不能直接用于图像-文本任务，反之亦然。学习真正的联合嵌入的一个主要障碍是缺乏所有模态同时出现的大规模多模态数据。

paras.en: In this paper, we present ImageBind, which learns a single shared representation space by leveraging multiple types of image-paired data. It does not need datasets where all modalities co-occur with each other. Instead, we leverage the binding property of images and we show that just aligning each modality’s embedding to image embeddings leads to an emergent alignment across all of the modalities. In practice, ImageBind leverages web-scale (image, text) paired data and combines it with naturally occurring paired data such as (video, audio), (image, depth) etc. to learn a single joint embedding space. This allows ImageBind to implicitly align the text embeddings to other modalities such as audio, depth etc., enabling zero-shot recognition capabilities on that modality without explicit semantic or textual pairing. Moreover, we show that it can be initialized with large-scale vision-language models such as CLIP [60], thereby leveraging the rich image and text representations of these models. Thus, ImageBind can be applied to a variety of different modalities and tasks with little training. We use large-scale image-text paired data along with naturally paired ‘self-supervised’ data across four new modalities - audio, depth, thermal, and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) readings – and show strong emergent zero-shot classification and retrieval performance on tasks for each of these modalities. These emergent properties improve as the underlying image representation is made stronger. On audio classification and retrieval benchmarks, ImageBind’s emergent zero-shot classification matches or outperforms specialist models trained with direct audio-text supervision on benchmarks like ESC, Clotho, AudioCaps. ImageBind representations also outperform specialist supervised models on few-shot evaluation benchmarks. Finally, we show that ImageBind’s joint embeddings can be used for a wide variety of compositional tasks as illustrated in Figure 1, including cross-modal retrieval, combining embeddings via arithmetic, detecting audio sources in images, and generating images given audio input.
paras.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了ImageBind，它通过利用多种类型的图像配对数据来学习单个共享表示空间。它不需要所有模态都相互共现的数据集。相反，我们利用图像的绑定属性，并表明仅将每个模态的嵌入与图像嵌入对齐，就会导致所有模态之间的涌现对齐。在实践中，ImageBind利用大规模（图像、文本）配对数据，并将其与自然出现的配对数据（如（视频、音频）、（图像、深度）等）相结合，以学习单个联合嵌入空间。这使得ImageBind能够隐式地将文本嵌入与其他模态（如音频、深度等）对齐，从而在没有显式语义或文本配对的情况下，实现对该模态的零样本识别能力。此外，我们表明它可以初始化自大规模视觉语言模型，如CLIP [60]，从而利用这些模型丰富的图像和文本表示。因此，ImageBind可以在很少训练的情况下应用于各种不同的模态和任务。我们使用大规模图像-文本配对数据以及自然配对的‘自监督’数据，涵盖四种新模态——音频、深度、热成像和惯性测量单元（IMU）读数——并在每种模态的任务上展示了强大的涌现零样本分类和检索性能。这些涌现属性随着底层图像表示的增强而改善。在音频分类和检索基准上，ImageBind的涌现零样本分类在ESC、Clotho、AudioCaps等基准上匹配或超越了使用直接音频-文本监督训练的专家模型。ImageBind表示在少样本评估基准上也优于专家监督模型。最后，我们表明ImageBind的联合嵌入可用于各种组合任务，如图1所示，包括跨模态检索、通过算术组合嵌入、检测图像中的音频源以及根据音频输入生成图像。

paras.en: ImageBind builds upon several advances in vision-language, multimodal, and self-supervised research. Language Image Pre-training. Training images jointly with linguistic signals like words or sentences has been shown to be an effective method for zero-shot, open-vocabulary recognition and text-to-image retrieval [14, 18, 38, 68]. Language as supervision can further be used for learning strong video representations [2, 47, 48]. Joulin et al. [34] show that using large-scale image dataset with noisy captions yields strong visual features. Recently, CLIP [60], ALIGN [31] and Florence [83] collect large collections of image and text pairs and train models to embed image and language inputs in a joint space using contrastive learning, exhibiting impressive zero-shot performance. CoCa [82]
paras.zh: ImageBind建立在视觉-语言、多模态和自监督研究的若干进展之上。语言图像预训练。将图像与单词或句子等语言信号联合训练已被证明是零样本、开放词汇识别和文本到图像检索的有效方法[14, 18, 38, 68]。语言作为监督信号还可用于学习强大的视频表征[2, 47, 48]。Joulin等人[34]表明，使用带有噪声标注的大规模图像数据集能够产生强视觉特征。最近，CLIP[60]、ALIGN[31]和Florence[83]收集了大量图文对，并训练模型使用对比学习将图像和语言输入嵌入到联合空间中，展现出令人印象深刻的零样本性能。CoCa[82]

paras.en: adds an image captioning objective on top of the contrastive loss for improved performance. Flamingo [1] handles arbitrarily interleaved images and texts, and achieves state of the art on many few-shot learning benchmarks. LiT [84] adopts contrastive training for fine-tuning and observes freezing image encoders works the best. This prior line of works mostly considers image and text, while our work enables zero-shot recognition on multiple modalities. Multi-Modal Learning. Our work binds multiple modality representations in a joint embedding space. Prior works explored joint training of multiple modalities in a supervised [21, 42] or self-supervised contexts [3, 20, 50, 70, 74]. The success of image and language pre-training methods such as CLIP has inspired approaches that revisit learning deep semantic representations through matching other modalities with linguistic inputs. Various methods adapt CLIP to extract semantically strong video representations [15, 43, 45, 79]. Most related to our method, Nagrani et al. [51] create a weakly-labeled dataset for paired video-audio and captions that allows for training multi-modal video-audio encoder to match textual features resulting in strong audio and video retrieval and captioning performance. AudioCLIP [27] adds audio as an additional modality into a CLIP framework, enabling zero-shot audio classification. In contrast, ImageBind does not require explicit paired data between all modalities and instead leverages image as a natural weak supervision for unifying modalities. Feature Alignment Pre-trained CLIP models have been utilized as teachers to supervise other models due to the strength of its visual representations [44, 58, 75]. Moreover, CLIP joint image and text embedding space has also been leveraged for a variety of zero-shot tasks like detection [24, 88], segmentation [41], mesh animation [81] etc. showing the power of joint embedding spaces. PointCLIP [85] finds a pre-trained CLIP encoder can be used for 3D recognition by projecting a point cloud to a number of 2D depth map views, which in turn are encoded using CLIP visual encoder. In multilingual neural machine translation, a similar phenomenon to the emergence behavior of ImageBind is commonly observed and utilized: if languages are trained in the same latent space through learned implicit bridging, translation can be done between language pairs on which no paired data is provided [33, 40].
paras.zh: 在对比损失基础上增加了图像描述目标以提升性能。Flamingo[1]处理任意交错排列的图像和文本，并在许多少样本学习基准上达到最先进水平。LiT[84]采用对比训练进行微调，并观察到冻结图像编码器效果最好。这些先前的工作主要考虑图像和文本，而我们的工作实现了对多种模态的零样本识别。多模态学习。我们的工作将多种模态表征绑定到联合嵌入空间中。先前的工作在监督[21, 42]或自监督[3, 20, 50, 70, 74]背景下探索了多模态的联合训练。图像和语言预训练方法（如CLIP）的成功启发了通过将其他模态与语言输入匹配来重新学习深度语义表征的方法。各种方法将CLIP适配用于提取语义强的视频表征[15, 43, 45, 79]。与我们方法最相关的是，Nagrani等人[51]创建了一个弱标注的视频-音频-字幕配对数据集，能够训练多模态视频-音频编码器以匹配文本特征，从而在音频和视频检索及描述任务上取得强劲性能。AudioCLIP[27]将音频作为额外模态加入CLIP框架，实现了零样本音频分类。相比之下，ImageBind不需要所有模态之间的显式配对数据，而是利用图像作为自然的弱监督来统一多种模态。特征对齐。预训练的CLIP模型因其视觉表征的强度而被用作教师模型来监督其他模型[44, 58, 75]。此外，CLIP的联合图像和文本嵌入空间也被用于各种零样本任务，如检测[24, 88]、分割[41]、网格动画[81]等，展示了联合嵌入空间的强大能力。PointCLIP[85]发现，预训练的CLIP编码器可通过将点云投影到多个2D深度图视图，然后使用CLIP视觉编码器编码，从而用于3D识别。在多语言神经机器翻译中，类似于ImageBind涌现行为的现象被普遍观察和利用：如果语言通过习得的隐式桥接在相同的潜在空间中训练，则可以在没有提供配对数据的语言对之间进行翻译[33, 40]。

paras.en: Our goal is to learn a single joint embedding space for all modalities by using images to bind them together. We align each modality’s embedding to image embeddings, such as text to image using web data and IMU to video using video data captured from egocentric cameras with IMU. We show that the resulting embedding space has a powerful emergent zero-shot behavior that automatically associates pairs of modalities without seeing any training data for that specific pair.
paras.zh: 我们的目标是利用图像将所有模态绑定在一起，学习一个统一的联合嵌入空间。我们将每个模态的嵌入与图像嵌入对齐，例如利用网络数据将文本与图像对齐，利用从配备IMU的自我中心摄像机捕获的视频数据将IMU与视频对齐。我们表明，得到的嵌入空间具有强大的涌现零样本行为，可以在未见过任何该特定对的训练数据的情况下自动关联模态对。

paras.en: Aligning specific pairs of modalities. Contrastive learning [28] is a general technique for learning an embedding space by using pairs of related examples (positives) and unrelated examples (negatives). Using pairs of aligned observations, contrastive learning can align pairs of modalities such as (image, text) [60], (audio, text) [27], (image, depth) [70], (video, audio) [50] etc. However, in each case, the joint embeddings are trained and evaluated using the same pairs of modalities. Thus, (video, audio) embeddings are not directly applicable for text-based tasks while (image, text) embeddings cannot be applied for audio tasks. Zero-shot image classification using text prompts. CLIP [60] popularized a ‘zero-shot’ classification task based on an aligned (image, text) embedding space. This involves constructing a list of text descriptions that describe the classes in a dataset. An input image is classified based on its similarity to the text descriptions in the embedding space. Unlocking such zero-shot classification for other modalities requires specifically training using paired text data, e.g., (audio, text) [27] or (point-clouds, text) [85]. In contrast, ImageBind unlocks zero-shot classification for modalities without paired text data.
paras.zh: 对齐特定模态对。对比学习[28]是一种通用的嵌入空间学习技术，通过使用相关样本（正样本）和不相关样本（负样本）对进行学习。利用对齐的观测对，对比学习可以对齐如（图像，文本）[60]、（音频，文本）[27]、（图像，深度图）[70]、（视频，音频）[50]等模态对。然而，每种情况下，联合嵌入都是使用相同的模态对进行训练和评估。因此，（视频，音频）嵌入不直接适用于基于文本的任务，而（图像，文本）嵌入也无法应用于音频任务。使用文本提示词的零样本图像分类。CLIP [60]推广了一种基于对齐的（图像，文本）嵌入空间的“零样本”分类任务。这涉及构建一个文本描述列表，描述数据集中的类别。输入图像根据其与嵌入空间中文本描述的相似度进行分类。要为其他模态实现这种零样本分类，需要专门使用配对文本数据进行训练，例如（音频，文本）[27]或（点云，文本）[85]。相比之下，ImageBind无需配对文本数据即可为非文本模态解锁零样本分类。

paras.en: IMAGE BIND uses pairs of modalities (I, M), where I represents images and M is another modality, to learn a single joint embedding. We use large-scale web datasets with (image, text) pairings that span a wide range of semantic concepts. Additionally, we use the natural, self-supervised pairing of other modalities – audio, depth, thermal, and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) – with images. Consider the pair of modalities (I, M) with aligned observations. Given an image I_i and its corresponding observation in the other modality M_i, we encode them into normalized embeddings: q_i = f(I_i) and k_i = g(M_i) where f, g are deep networks. The embeddings and the encoders
paras.zh: IMAGE BIND 使用模态对 (I, M)（其中 I 表示图像，M 是另一种模态）来学习一个单一的联合嵌入。我们使用涵盖广泛语义概念的大规模网络数据集（图像，文本）配对。此外，我们还利用其他模态（音频、深度、热成像和惯性测量单元（IMU））与图像的自然自监督配对。考虑具有对齐观测的模态对 (I, M)。给定图像 I_i 及其在另一种模态中的对应观测 M_i，我们将它们编码为归一化嵌入：q_i = f(I_i) 和 k_i = g(M_i)，其中 f, g 是深度网络。嵌入和编码器

paras.en: where \tau\ is a scalar temperature that controls the smoothness of the softmax distribution and j denotes unrelated observations, also called 'negatives'. We follow [76] and consider every example j \neq i\ in the mini-batch to be a negative. The loss makes the embeddings q_i and k_i closer in the joint embedding space, and thus aligns I and M. In practice, we use a symmetric loss \mathcal{L}_{I,M} + \mathcal{L}_{M,I}\. Emergent alignment of unseen pairs of modalities. IMAGE BIND uses modalities paired with images, i.e., pairs of the form (I, M) to align each the embeddings from each modality M to those from images. We observe an emergent behavior in the embedding space that aligns two pairs of modalities (M_1, M_2) even though we only train using the pairs (I, M_1) and (I, M_2). This behavior allows us to perform a wide variety of zero-shot and cross-modal retrieval tasks without training for them. We achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot text-audio classification results without observing a single sample of paired (audio, text).

paras.en: IMAGE BIND is conceptually simple and can be implemented in many different ways. We deliberately choose a vanilla implementation that is flexible and allows for an effective study and easy adoption. In § 5, we present design decisions that are critical for good emergent ‘binding’. Encoding modalities. We use a Transformer architecture [73] for all the modality encoders. We use the Vision Transformer (ViT) [13] for images. Following [20], we use the same encoder for images and videos. We temporally inflate [7] the patch projection layer of the ViT and use 2 frame video clips sampled from 2 seconds. We follow [22] for encoding audio and convert a 2 second audio sampled at 16kHz into spectrograms using 128 mel-spectrogram bins. As the spectrogram is also a 2D signal like an image, we use a ViT with a patch size of 16 and stride 10. We treat thermal images and depth images as one-channel images and
paras.zh: IMAGE BIND 在概念上很简单，并且可以通过多种方式实现。我们特意选择了一个简洁的实现，它灵活且便于有效研究和轻松采用。在第5节中，我们介绍了对良好涌现“绑定”至关重要的设计决策。编码模态。我们对所有模态编码器使用 Transformer 架构 [73]。对图像使用 Vision Transformer (ViT) [13]。遵循 [20]，我们对图像和视频使用相同的编码器。我们暂时膨胀 [7] ViT 的块投影层，并使用从 2 秒中采样的 2 帧视频片段。我们遵循 [22] 对音频进行编码，将 16kHz 采样的 2 秒音频转换为使用 128 个梅尔频谱图 bin 的频谱图。由于频谱图也是像图像一样的 2D 信号，我们使用块大小为 16、步长为 10 的 ViT。我们将热图像和深度图像视为单通道图像，

paras.en: also use a ViT to encode them. We follow [21] to convert depth into disparity maps for scale invariance. We extract the IMU signal consisting of accelerometer and gyroscope measurements across the X, Y, and Z axes. We use 5 second clips resulting in 2K time step IMU readings which are projected using a 1D convolution with a kernel size of 8. The resulting sequence is encoded using a Transformer. Finally, we follow the text encoder design from CLIP [60]. We use separate encoders for images, text, audio, thermal images, depth images, and IMU. We add a modality-specific linear projection head on each encoder to obtain a fixed size d dimensional embedding, that is normalized and used in the InfoNCE loss from Eq 1. In addition to ease of learning, this setup allows us to also initialize a subset of the encoders using pretrained models, e.g., the image and text encoder using CLIP [60] or OpenCLIP [30].
paras.zh: 也使用 ViT 对它们进行编码。我们遵循 [21] 将深度转换为视差图以实现尺度不变性。我们提取 IMU 信号，包括 X、Y 和 Z 轴上的加速度计和陀螺仪测量值。我们使用 5 秒的片段，产生 2K 时间步长的 IMU 读数，这些读数通过内核大小为 8 的 1D 卷积进行投影。生成的序列使用 Transformer 编码。最后，我们遵循 CLIP [60] 的文本编码器设计。我们对图像、文本、音频、热图像、深度图像和 IMU 使用单独的编码器。我们在每个编码器上添加一个模态特定的线性投影头，以获得固定大小的 d 维嵌入，该嵌入被归一化并用于公式 1 中的 InfoNCE 损失。除了易于学习之外，这种设置还允许我们使用预训练模型初始化一部分编码器，例如使用 CLIP [60] 或 OpenCLIP [30] 初始化图像和文本编码器。

paras.en: We first describe the main experimental setup and provide full details in the supplement. Naturally paired modalities and datasets. We use ImageBind on six modalities - image/video, text, audio, depth, thermal images, and IMU. As described in § 3.3, we treat videos as 2 frame images and process them the same as images. For the naturally available paired data, we use the (video, audio) pairs from the Audioset dataset [19], (image, depth) pairs from the SUN RGB-D dataset [69], (image, thermal) pairs from the LLVIP dataset [32] and (video, IMU) pairs from the Ego4D dataset [23]. For these pairs of modalities, we do not use any extra supervision like class labels, text etc. Since SUN RGB-D and LLVIP are relatively small, we follow [21] and replicate them 50× for training. Large scale image-text pairs. We leverage image-text supervision from large-scale web data [60]. For ease of experimentation, we use pretrained models that are trained on billions of (image, text) pairs. Specifically, we use the
paras.zh: 我们首先描述主要实验设置，并在补充材料中提供完整细节。自然配对模态与数据集。我们在六种模态上使用ImageBind——图像/视频、文本、音频、深度、热成像和IMU。如§3.3所述，我们将视频视为2帧图像，并采用与图像相同的处理方式。对于自然可用的配对数据，我们使用Audioset数据集[19]中的（视频，音频）对、SUN RGB-D数据集[69]中的（图像，深度）对、LLVIP数据集[32]中的（图像，热成像）对以及Ego4D数据集[23]中的（视频，IMU）对。对于这些模态对，我们不使用任何额外的监督信息，如类别标签、文本等。由于SUN RGB-D和LLVIP规模相对较小，我们遵循[21]的做法，在训练中将它们复制50倍。大规模图像-文本对。我们利用来自大规模网络数据[60]的图像-文本监督。为便于实验，我们使用在数十亿（图像，文本）对上预训练的模型。具体来说，我们使用

paras.en: pretrained vision (ViT-H 630M params) and text encoders (302M params) from OpenCLIP [11, 30]. Encoders for each modality. We convert audio into 2D mel-spectrograms [22], and thermal and depth modalities into 1 channel images and use ViT-B, ViT-S encoders respectively. The image and text encoders are kept frozen during the ImageBind training and the audio, depth, thermal, and IMU encoders are updated. Emergent zero-shot vs. zero-shot. Methods such as CLIP [60], AudioCLIP [27] etc. train with modality pairs, (image, text) and (audio, text), to demonstrate zero-shot classification using text-prompts for the same modality. In contrast, ImageBind binds modalities together using only image-paired data. Thus, just by training on (image, text) and (image, audio), ImageBind can perform zero-shot classification of audio using text prompts. As we do not directly train for this ability, we term it emergent zero-shot classification to distinguish it from methods that specifically train using paired text-supervision for all modalities. Evaluation on downstream tasks. We comprehensively evaluate ImageBind on a many different downstream tasks using different protocols. We summarize the main datasets used for evaluation in Table 1.
paras.zh: 来自OpenCLIP [11, 30]的预训练视觉（ViT-H 630M参数）和文本编码器（302M参数）。各模态编码器。我们将音频转换为2D梅尔频谱图[22]，将热成像和深度模态转换为单通道图像，并分别使用ViT-B和ViT-S编码器。在ImageBind训练期间，图像和文本编码器保持冻结，而音频、深度、热成像和IMU编码器进行更新。涌现式零样本与零样本。CLIP [60]、AudioCLIP [27]等方法使用模态对（图像，文本）和（音频，文本）进行训练，以展示使用文本提示对同一模态进行零样本分类。相比之下，ImageBind仅使用图像配对数据将各模态绑定在一起。因此，仅通过（图像，文本）和（图像，音频）训练，ImageBind即可使用文本提示对音频执行零样本分类。由于我们不直接训练此能力，我们将其称为涌现式零样本分类，以区别于专门使用所有模态配对文本监督进行训练的方法。下游任务评估。我们全面评估了ImageBind在多种不同下游任务上的表现，采用了不同的评估协议。我们在表1中总结了用于评估的主要数据集。

paras.en: We evaluate ImageBind on emergent zero-shot classification and use the text prompt templates from [60] (full details in Appendix B). We report the results in Table 2. Each task measures ImageBind's ability to associate text embeddings to the other modalities without observing them together during training. Given the novelty of our problem setting, there are no "fair" baselines to compare ImageBind with. Nevertheless, we compare to prior work that uses text paired with certain modalities (e.g. audio [27, 51]), and for certain "visual-like" modalities such as depth and thermal, we use the CLIP model directly. We also report the best reported supervised upper bound per benchmark. ImageBind achieves a high emergent zero-shot classification performance. On each benchmark, ImageBind achieves strong gains and even compares favorably to supervised specialist models trained for the specific modality and task. These results demonstrate that ImageBind aligns the modalities and implicitly transfers the text supervision associated with images to other modalities like audio. In particular, ImageBind shows strong alignment for non-visual modalities like audio and IMU suggesting that their naturally available pairing with images is a powerful source of supervision. For completeness, we also report the standard zero-shot image (ImageNet [63] - IN1K, Places-365 [87] P365) and video (Kinetics400 [35] - K400, MSR-VTT 1kA [78] - MSR-VTT) tasks. As the image & text encoders are initialized (and frozen) using OpenCLIP, these results match those of OpenCLIP.
paras.zh: 我们评估了ImageBind在涌现式零样本分类上的性能，并使用了来自[60]的文本提示模板（完整细节见附录B）。结果列于表2。每个任务衡量ImageBind在不观察文本与其他模态配对的情况下，将文本嵌入与其关联的能力。鉴于我们问题设置的新颖性，没有“公平”的基线可与ImageBind比较。尽管如此，我们与使用文本与特定模态（如音频[27,51]）配对的先前工作进行了比较，对于某些“类似视觉”的模态如深度和热成像，我们直接使用CLIP模型。我们还报告了每个基准的最佳监督上界。ImageBind取得了高涌现式零样本分类性能。在每个基准上，ImageBind获得了显著提升，甚至与针对特定模态和任务训练的监督专家模型相比也不逊色。这些结果表明ImageBind对齐了模态，并将与图像关联的文本监督隐式转移到了其他模态（如音频）。特别是，ImageBind在非视觉模态（如音频和IMU）上表现出强对齐，表明它们与图像的自然配对是一个强大的监督源。为完整起见，我们还报告了标准的零样本图像（ImageNet [63] - IN1K, Places-365 [87] - P365）和视频（Kinetics400 [35] - K400, MSR-VTT 1kA [78] - MSR-VTT）任务。由于图像和文本编码器使用OpenCLIP初始化（并冻结），这些结果与OpenCLIP一致。

paras.en: We now compare ImageBind against prior work in zero-shot retrieval and classification tasks. Zero-shot text to audio retrieval and classification. Unlike ImageBind, prior work trains using paired data for that modality, e.g., AudioCLIP [27] uses (audio, text) supervision and AVFIC [52] uses automatically mined (audio, text) pairs. We compare their zero-shot text to audio retrieval and classification performance to ImageBind’s emergent retrieval and classification in Table 3. ImageBind significantly outperforms prior work on the audio text retrieval benchmarks. On the Clotho dataset, ImageBind has double the performance of AVFIC despite not using any text pairing for audio during training. Compared to the supervised AudioCLIP model, ImageBind achieves comparable audio classification performance on ESC. Note that AudioCLIP uses class names from AudioSet as text targets for audio-text training, hence is referred to as ‘supervised’.

paras.en: ImageBind’s strong performance on all three benchmarks validates its ability to align the audio and text modalities using images as a bridge. Text to audio and video retrieval. We use the MSR-VTT 1k-A benchmark to evaluate the text to audio and video retrieval performance in Table 4. Only using audio, ImageBind achieves strong emergent retrieval performance compared to the video retrieval performance of prior work like MIL-NCE. The text to video performance for our model is strong (36.1% R@1 in Table 2) as it uses OpenCLIP’s vision and text encoders and outperforms many prior methods. However, combining the audio and video modalities further boosts performance showing the utility of ImageBind’s features over an already strong retrieval model.
paras.zh: ImageBind 在所有三个基准上的强劲性能验证了其使用图像作为桥梁对齐音频和文本模态的能力。文本到音频和视频检索。我们使用 MSR-VTT 1k-A 基准来评估表 4 中的文本到音频和视频检索性能。仅使用音频，ImageBind 与先前工作（如 MIL-NCE）的视频检索性能相比，实现了强劲的涌现检索性能。我们模型的文本到视频性能强劲（表 2 中 R@1 为 36.1%），因为它使用了 OpenCLIP 的视觉和文本编码器，并优于许多先前方法。然而，结合音频和视频模态进一步提升了性能，显示了 ImageBind 特征在已有强大检索模型上的效用。

paras.en: Multimodal embedding space arithmetic. We study whether ImageBind's embeddings can be used to compose information across modalities. In Figure 4, we show image retrievals obtained by adding together image and audio embeddings. The joint embedding space allows us to compose two embeddings: e.g., image of fruits on a table + sound of chirping birds and retrieve an image that contains both these concepts, i.e., fruits on trees with birds. Such emergent compositionality whereby semantic content from different modalities can be composed will likely enable a rich variety of compositional tasks. Without re-training, we can 'upgrade' existing vision models that use CLIP embeddings to use ImageBind embeddings from other modalities such as audio. Upgrading text-based detectors to audio-based. We use a
paras.zh: 多模态嵌入空间算术。我们研究ImageBind的嵌入是否可用于跨模态组合信息。在图4中，我们展示了通过将图像和音频嵌入相加得到的图像检索结果。联合嵌入空间使我们能够组合两个嵌入：例如，桌上的水果图像 + 鸟鸣声，并检索出包含这两个概念的图像，即树上带鸟的水果。这种新兴的组合性，使得不同模态的语义内容可以组合，有望实现丰富多样的组合任务。无需重新训练，我们就可以将使用CLIP嵌入的现有视觉模型“升级”为使用来自其他模态（如音频）的ImageBind嵌入。将基于文本的检测器升级为基于音频的检测器。我们使用一个

paras.en: pretrained text-based detection model, Detic [88], and simply replace its CLIP-based 'class' (text) embeddings with ImageBind's audio embeddings. Without training, this creates an 'audio'-based detector that can detect and segment objects based on audio prompts. As shown in Figure 5, we can prompt the detector with the barking sound of a dog to localize a dog. Upgrading text-based diffusion models to audio-based. We use a pretrained DALLE-2 [61] diffusion model (private reimplementation) and replace its prompt embeddings by our audio embeddings. In Figure 1, we observe that we can repurpose the diffusion model to generate plausible images using different types of sounds.

paras.en: We investigate various design choices for learning a joint embedding space for different modalities. Since the ablation experimental setup is similar to § 4, we only note the main differences (full details in Appendix C). We report results on the ESC fold-1 for the ablation study. We use a ViT-B encoder for the image, audio, depth, and thermal modalities by default and train them for 16 epochs (vs. 32 epochs in § 4).

paras.en: For IMU we use a lightweight 6-layer encoder with 512-dimensional width and 8 heads, and train it for 8 epochs. The text encoder follows [60] and is a twelve-layer Transformer with a width of 512 dimensions. We initialize the image and text encoder from the CLIP model [60].
paras.zh: 对于 IMU，我们使用一个轻量级的 6 层编码器，宽度为 512 维，8 个注意力头，并训练 8 个周期。文本编码器遵循 [60]，是一个 12 层 Transformer，宽度为 512 维。我们使用 CLIP 模型 [60] 初始化图像和文本编码器。

paras.en: The central idea in ImageBind is aligning the embeddings of all modalities to image embeddings. Thus, the image embeddings play a central role in the emergent alignment of unseen modalities and we study their effect on the emergent zero-shot performance. We vary the size of the image encoder and train an encoder for the depth, audio, etc. modalities to match the image representation. To isolate the effect of the image representation, we fix the size of the other modality encoders. We use the pretrained CLIP (ViT-B and ViT-L) and OpenCLIP (ViT-H) image and text encoders for this experiment. Our results in Figure 6 show that ImageBind’s emergent zero-shot performance on all modalities improves with better visual features. For depth and audio classification, the stronger ViT-H vs. the ViT-B image encoder provides a gain of 7% and 4% respectively. Thus, stronger visual features can improve recognition performance even on non-visual modalities.
paras.zh: ImageBind 的核心思想是将所有模态的嵌入对齐到图像嵌入。因此，图像嵌入在未见模态的涌现对齐中起核心作用，我们研究了它们对涌现零样本性能的影响。我们改变图像编码器的大小，并为深度、音频等模态训练编码器以匹配图像表示。为了隔离图像表示的影响，我们固定其他模态编码器的大小。我们在此实验中使用预训练的 CLIP（ViT-B 和 ViT-L）和 OpenCLIP（ViT-H）图像和文本编码器。图 6 的结果表明，ImageBind 在所有模态上的涌现零样本性能随着更好的视觉特征而提升。对于深度和音频分类，更强的 ViT-H 相对于 ViT-B 图像编码器分别提供了 7% 和 4% 的提升。因此，更强的视觉特征甚至可以改善非视觉模态的识别性能。

paras.en: We study the effect of training design choices on emergent zero-shot classification. We focus on two modalities with different characteristics: depth (visual and spatial) and audio (non-visual, temporal). We find that studying diverse modalities leads to robust and transferable design decisions. Contrastive loss temperature: We study the effect of the

paras.en: temperature τ (Eq. 1) in Table 5a. We experiment with a learnable temperature initialized to 0.07 (parameterized in log-scale) following [60] vs. various fixed temperatures. Unlike [60], we observe that a fixed temperature is best for depth, audio, and IMU classification. Additionally, we see that a higher temperature is better for training the depth, thermal, and IMU encoders, whereas a lower temperature works best for audio. Projection head: We vary the projection head for each encoder from a linear layer to an MLP with 768 hidden dimensions. Results in Table 5b show that a linear projection performs better for both modalities. This contrasts with standard self-supervised methods like SimCLR [10] whose performance improves with MLP projection heads. Training epochs: We vary the number of training epochs and report classification performance in Table 5c. Longer training consistently improves emergent zero-shot performance for both modalities across all datasets. Data augmentation for paired images: During ImageBind training, we augment images using either basic augmentation (cropping, color jitter) or strong augmentation that also includes RandAugment [12] and RandErase [86]. Augmentation parameters are in Appendix C. Stronger augmentation helps depth classification when training on the small (image, depth) pairs from SUN RGB-D. However, for audio, heavily augmenting the video makes the task too challenging, causing a 34% drop on ESC. Depth-specific design choices: We vary spatial crop types in Table 5e. Following CMC [70], we use two unaligned random crops from the corresponding image and depth pair vs. our default spatially aligned random crops. Contrary to CMC, we observe that random cropping severely degrades performance (more than 10% on SUN-D). Unlike vanilla self-supervised learning, our image representations from image-text pairs are more semantic, so spatially misaligned crops hurt performance. In Table 5f, RandomErase [86] boosts depth classification. Audio-specific design choices: We train for video-audio alignment using temporally aligned or unaligned samples, measuring final performance in Table 5g. Similar to depth, temporally aligned samples yield better performance. Table 5h shows that frequency masking augmentation for audio provides a small performance boost. The capacity of audio and depth encoders and their impact on classification performance are reported in Table 6. A smaller encoder for depth improves performance, presumably due to the small (image, depth) dataset size. Conversely, a larger audio encoder improves performance, especially when paired with a high-capacity image encoder.
paras.zh: 温度 τ（式 1）在表 5a 中的效果。我们参照 [60] 实验了初始化为 0.07（采用对数尺度参数化）的可学习温度与各种固定温度值。与 [60] 不同，我们观察到固定温度对深度、音频和 IMU 分类效果最佳。此外，我们发现较高温度更适合训练深度、热成像和 IMU 编码器，而较低温度对音频模态效果最好。投影头：我们将每个编码器的投影头从线性层变为具有 768 隐藏维度的 MLP。表 5b 的结果显示，线性投影对两种模态表现更好。这与标准自监督方法（如 SimCLR [10]，其性能随 MLP 投影头提升）形成对比。训练轮数：我们改变训练轮数并在表 5c 中报告分类性能。更长的训练持续提升两种模态在所有数据集上的涌现式零样本性能。配对图像的数据增强：在 ImageBind 训练期间，我们使用基本增强（裁剪、色彩抖动）或强力增强（额外应用 RandAugment [12] 和 RandErase [86]）来增强图像。增强参数见附录 C。在 SUN RGB-D 的小规模（图像、深度）对上训练时，更强的增强有助于深度分类。然而，对于音频，对视频进行强增强会使任务过于困难，导致 ESC 上下降 34%。深度特定设计选择：我们在表 5e 中改变用于训练的空间裁剪类型。遵循 CMC [70]，我们使用对应图像-深度对的两个未对齐随机裁剪，而我们默认使用空间对齐随机裁剪。与 CMC 相反，我们观察到随机裁剪严重降低性能（SUN-D 上超过 10%）。与普通自监督学习不同，我们从图像-文本对中学到的图像表示更具语义性，因此空间未对齐裁剪会损害性能。在表 5f 中，RandErase [86] 提升了深度分类性能。音频特定设计选择：我们使用时间对齐或未对齐样本进行视频-音频对齐训练，并在表 5g 中测量最终性能。与深度分类的发现类似，时间对齐样本带来更好性能。表 5h 显示，对音频使用频率掩码增强也能小幅提升性能。音频和深度编码器的容量及其对分类性能的影响在表 6 中报告。较小的深度编码器能提升性能，可能是因为（图像、深度）数据集规模较小。相反，较大的音频编码器能提升性能，尤其是与高容量图像编码器配对时。

paras.en: Table 6 shows the capacity of audio and depth encoders and their impact on performance. A stronger image encoder improves performance for both audio and depth tasks. As the number of (image, depth) pairs is small, a smaller encoder improves performance for depth. For audio classification, a larger encoder is better.
paras.zh: 表 6 展示了音频和深度编码器的容量及其对性能的影响。更强的图像编码器能提升音频和深度任务的性能。由于（图像、深度）对数量较少，较小的编码器能提升深度性能。对于音频分类，较大的编码器效果更好。

paras.en: Effect of batch size: In Table 7, we evaluate the effect of batch size on the learned representation. As shown, the batch size can vary across modalities depending on the size and complexity of the corresponding pretraining datasets. ImageBind to evaluate pretrained vision models in Table 8: We initialize the vision encoder using a pretrained model and keep it fixed. We use image-paired data to align and train text, audio, and depth encoders (full details in Appendix B). Compared to the supervised DeiT model, the self-supervised DINO model is better at emergent zero-shot classification on both depth and audio modalities. Moreover, the emergent zero-shot performance is not correlated with pure vision performance on ImageNet, suggesting that these tasks measure different properties. ImageBind can serve as a valuable tool to measure vision models' strength on multimodal applications.
paras.zh: 批量大小的影响：在表 7 中，我们评估了批量大小对所学表示的影响。如图所示，批量大小可根据对应预训练数据集的大小和复杂性在不同模态间变化。将 ImageBind 作为评估预训练视觉模型的工具（表 8）：我们使用预训练模型初始化视觉编码器并保持其固定。我们使用图像配对数据来对齐并训练文本、音频和深度编码器（详见附录 B）。与监督式 DeiT 模型相比，自监督 DINO 模型在深度和音频模态上的涌现式零样本分类表现更好。此外，涌现式零样本性能与 ImageNet 上的纯视觉性能不相关，表明这些任务衡量了不同属性。ImageBind 可作为有价值的工具，用于衡量视觉模型在多模态应用中的能力。

paras.en: Table 8 shows ImageBind as an evaluation tool. We initialize (and fix) the image encoder with different methods and align other modalities. ImageBind measures the impact of visual features on multimodal tasks. DINO [6] achieves 64.4, 17.2, 44.7, 26.8, 48.8 on IN1K, VGGS, ESC, SUN-D, and NYU-D respectively, while DeiT [72] achieves 74.4†, 9.6, 25.0, 25.2, 48.0. † indicates trained with IN1K supervision.
paras.zh: 表 8 展示了 ImageBind 作为评估工具的效果。我们使用不同方法初始化（并固定）图像编码器，然后对齐其他模态。ImageBind 衡量了视觉特征对多模态任务的影响。DINO [6] 在 IN1K、VGGS、ESC、SUN-D 和 NYU-D 上分别达到 64.4、17.2、44.7、26.8、48.8，而 DeiT [72] 达到 74.4†、9.6、25.0、25.2、48.0。†表示使用 IN1K 监督训练。

paras.en: ImageBind is a simple and practical way to train a joint embedding space using only image alignment. Our method leads to emergent alignment across all modalities which can be measured using cross-modal retrieval and text-based zero-shot tasks. We enable a rich set of compositional multimodal tasks across different modalities, show a way to evaluate pretrained vision models for non-vision tasks and ‘upgrade’ models like Detic and DALL-E 2 to use audio. There are multiple ways to further improve ImageBind. Our image alignment loss can be enriched by using other alignment data, for instance other modalities paired with text, or with each other (e.g. audio with IMU). Our embeddings are trained without a specific downstream task, and thus lag the performance of specialist models. More research into adapting general purpose embeddings for each task, including structured prediction tasks such as detection will be beneficial. Finally, new benchmarks, e.g. our emergent zero-shot task to measure emergent abilities of multimodal models, would help create exciting new applications. Our model is a research prototype and cannot be readily used for real world applications (Appendix F). paras.zh: ImageBind 是一种简单实用的方法，仅使用图像对齐来训练联合嵌入空间。我们的方法在所有模态中产生了涌现对齐，可以通过跨模态检索和基于文本的零样本任务来衡量。我们实现了跨不同模态的丰富组合多模态任务，展示了一种评估非视觉任务的预训练视觉模型，并“升级”模型（如 Detic 和 DALL-E 2）以使用音频的方法。有多种方式可以进一步改进 ImageBind。我们的图像对齐损失可以通过使用其他对齐数据（例如与文本配对的其它模态，或彼此配对（如音频与 IMU））来丰富。我们的嵌入是在没有特定下游任务的情况下训练的，因此落后于专家模型的性能。将通用嵌入适应每个任务（包括结构化预测任务，如检测）的更多研究将是有益的。最后，新的基准测试（例如我们用于测量多模态模型涌现能力的零样本任务）将有助于创建令人兴奋的新应用。我们的模型是一个研究原型，不能直接用于现实世界的应用（附录 F）。致谢：作者感谢 Uriel Singer、Adam Polyak 和 Naman Goyal 在 DALL-E 2 实验中的帮助，以及整个 Meta AI 团队的许多有益讨论。

paras.en: A. Datasets and Metrics Audioset (AS) [19]. This dataset is used for both training and evaluation. It contains 10s videos from YouTube annotated into 527 classes. It consists of 3 pre-defined splits, the balanced split with about 20K videos, test split with 18K videos, and an unbalanced training split with about 2M videos. For training, we use the 2M unbalanced set without any labels, and only use it for audio-video matching. For zero-shot evaluation in Table 2, we use the test set and compute logits for each class using the textual class names along with the templates as described later in Appendix B.3. The task here is “Environmental Sound Classification” (ESC). It consists of 2000 5s audio clips classified into 50 classes. It has predefined 5 fold evaluation, each consisting of 400 test audio clips. In this work, we compute zero-shot predictions on the evaluation set for each fold and report the 5-fold average performance. For ablations we use only the first fold for computational ease. The metric used is top-1 accuracy. Clotho (Clotho) [17]. This is a dataset of audio from the Freesound platform with textual descriptions. paras.en: A.1. Data Representations We use the standard RGB and RGBT representations for images and videos. For videos, we use 2-frame clips, inspired from recent work on ViT-style video architectures [16, 71], where a video patch is 2×16×16 (T×H×W ). We inflate the visual encoder’s weights to work with spatiotemporal patches and at inference time we aggregate features over multiple 2-frame clips. Hence, we can use models trained on image-text data directly on videos. We used a single-channel image for the thermal data since it is the natural form in which current infrared thermal sensors return data [32]. For single-view depth, we experimented with different encodings – absolute depth [66] as returned by sensors like the Kinect, inverse depth [62], disparity [62], and HHA [25, 26]. Overall, we found that disparity representation (which is a single-channel image) worked the best. For audio we use the raw waveform processed into mel-spectrograms [22], as described in the main text. For IMU we use a 6 × T tensor to represent the sequence of IMU sensor readings over time.
paras.zh: A.1. 数据表示 我们使用标准的RGB和RGBT表示用于图像和视频。对于视频，我们采用2帧片段，受近期ViT风格视频架构[16, 71]的启发，其中视频块大小为2×16×16 (T×H×W)。我们膨胀视觉编码器的权重以处理时空块，并在推理时聚合多个2帧片段的特征。因此，我们可以将在图像-文本数据上训练的模型直接应用于视频。对于热数据，我们使用单通道图像，因为这是当前红外热传感器返回数据的自然形式[32]。对于单视图深度，我们实验了不同的编码方式——传感器（如Kinect）返回的绝对深度[66]、逆深度[62]、视差[62]和HHA[25, 26]。总体而言，我们发现视差表示（单通道图像）效果最佳。对于音频，我们按照正文描述，使用经处理为梅尔频谱图[22]的原始波形。对于IMU，我们使用6×T张量来表示IMU传感器读数随时间变化的序列。

paras.zh: B. 评估细节 我们现在描述本工作中使用的评估设置。

paras.en: B.1. Inference implementation details Audio/Video: For both these temporal modalities (whether operated upon together during pre-training or separately during inference), we sample fixed length clips to operate on. During training, we randomly sample a clip, typically 2s in length. At inference time, we uniformly sample multiple clips to cover the full length of the input sample. For instance, for 5s ESC videos, we would sample \(\lceil 5/2 \rceil = 3\) clips. For video clips, we sample a fixed number of frames from each clip. For audio, we process each raw audio waveform by sampling it at 16KHz followed by extracting a log mel spectrogram with 128 frequency bins using a 25ms Hamming window with hop length of 10ms. Hence, for a t second audio we get a \(128 \times 100t\) dimensional input. IMU: For IMU, we sample fixed length clips of 5 seconds, centered around time-stamps that are aligned with narrations. For each clip, we get a \(6 \times 2000\) dimensional input and we measure the zero-shot performance for scenario classification using each clip as an independent testing sample.
paras.zh: B.1. 推理实现细节 音频/视频：对于这两种时间模态（无论是在预训练期间一起操作还是推理期间分别操作），我们采样固定长度的片段进行处理。在训练期间，我们随机采样一个片段，通常长度为2秒。在推理时，我们均匀采样多个片段以覆盖输入样本的整个长度。例如，对于5秒的ESC视频，我们将采样⌈5/2⌉=3个片段。对于视频片段，我们从每个片段中采样固定数量的帧。对于音频，我们以16KHz采样率处理每个原始音频波形，然后使用25ms汉明窗（跳跃长度10ms）提取具有128个频率 bin 的对数梅尔频谱图。因此，对于t秒音频，得到128×100t维输入。IMU：对于IMU，我们采样固定长度为5秒的片段，这些片段以与叙述对齐的时间戳为中心。对于每个片段，我们得到6×2000维输入，并使用每个片段作为独立测试样本测量场景分类的零样本性能。

paras.en: E. Additional Ablations Design choices in losses. Since the modality-specific encoders are trained to align with a frozen image encoder, we tried using a \ℓ_2\ regression objective. However, it did not improve over using only the contrastive objective (31.74%).

paras.en: F. Ethical considerations ImageBind learns a joint embedding for multiple modalities. Such an embedding is intended to associate semantically related concepts from different modalities. However, such an embedding may also create unintentional associations. Thus, joint embedding models, including ImageBind, must be studied carefully with a lens towards measuring such associations, and their implications. ImageBind leverages the image-text embeddings learned by a pretrained model on large web-based data which has biases as documented in different studies [60]. For learning joint embeddings for other modalities such as audio, thermal, depth, and IMU we leverage datasets mentioned in Appendix A. These joint embeddings are thus limited to the concepts present in the datasets. For example, the thermal datasets we used are limited to outdoor street scenes, while the depth datasets are limited to indoor scenes.
paras.zh: F. 伦理考虑 ImageBind学习多模态的联合嵌入。这种嵌入旨在关联来自不同模态的语义相关概念。然而，这种嵌入也可能产生无意的关联。因此，包括ImageBind在内的联合嵌入模型必须仔细研究，以衡量此类关联及其影响。ImageBind利用预训练模型在大规模网络数据上学习到的图像-文本嵌入，这些数据存在不同研究[60]中记录的偏见。为了学习其他模态（如音频、热成像、深度和IMU）的联合嵌入，我们利用了附录A中提到的数据集。因此，这些联合嵌入仅限于数据集中存在的概念。例如，我们使用的热成像数据集仅限于户外街景，而深度数据集仅限于室内场景。
